provenance.data_source: pinned AusTraits v7.0.0 native original source species median K

aim: Determine how the descriptive probability of changing the sign of a between-trait Blomberg K contrast after forcing identical tips and trees varies with original absolute logK difference and shared-species coverage, without treating the 760 within-family comparisons as independent studies.

estimands.sign_reversal: delta_original_logK * delta_shared_logK < 0 for valid matched-tree axes
estimands.original_gap: abs(delta_original_logK), from original independently supported trait-specific species/tip K
estimands.shared_tip_count: n_shared, not necessarily native prune tip count
estimands.consistency_check: delta_shared_logK == log(K_A / K_B) and source support system IDs/family/trait pair match original K-blind frozen graph

uncertainty.independence_cluster: Plant family (42 clusters); never binomial CI over 760 dependent pair rows
report_types: pair-weighted reversal rate and family-resampled 95% percentile interval
equal-family-mean reversal rate and family-resampled 95% percentile interval
margin and larger-cohort-coverage stratum pair-weighted rates and family-resampled 95% descriptive intervals
uncertainty.empty_strata: Never count a bootstrap draw with zero sampled eligible pairs. Fail if this occurs excessively.

exploratory_adjusted_model.primary_descriptive_link: GEE logistic with exchangeable working correlation by family; covariates original absolute logK gap, 1 - fraction of larger original cohort retained, log shared species count
exploratory_adjusted_model.secondary_sensitivity: OLS linear probability model with family and named-trait-pair fixed effects, cluster-robust by family, to check within-family/pair confounding of coverage associations
exploratory_adjusted_model.avoid_overclaim: All coefficients, intervals and p-values are post-760-data descriptive sensitivity; the sign threshold mechanically depends on original gap and source subset changes; adjustment does not identify causal sampling or evolutionary rate effects.

scientific_limits: Within-family trait-pair comparisons are strongly dependent and their family distribution uneven; report both family-balanced and pair-weighted reversal rates.
Between-pair intersections do not define a single transitive 12-trait K hierarchy.
Absolute logK gap is observed before matched-tip reanalysis, not a prospective evolutionary property.
Source overlap fraction and pair tip size are correlated; model association is not causal.
No changes to original Brownian, OU, source-variation, named-trait or BIEN stop-rule results.
No TRY v7 independent dataset has been source-qualified and five signed focal traits were selected post-original-K.
